versions.changelog: Description update: reframed as a local dropbox between you and your agent — a drag-and-drop folder to your agent and a viewable library of what it sends back. No functional changes.

Initial public release. Two-way local file bridge (Drop to Agent / Drop from Agent) with no account or external service. v0.2 hardened: filename sanitization, symlink/traversal guards, Host/Origin checks, size and upload limits, loopback-default bind.
